# Vendored from the Agent Receipt Protocol (Apache-2.0)

Source: https://github.com/agent-receipts/obsigna (spec v0.5.0/v0.6.0), copied 2026-10-18, unmodified.

| File | Used for |
|---|---|
| agent-receipt.schema.json, parameters-disclosure.schema.json | validating receipts exported by `toAgentReceipt()` |
| action-types.json | mapping Histor actions to the standard action taxonomy |
| canonicalization_vectors.json, v050_vectors.json | proving byte-for-byte RFC 8785 and signature interop in our test suite |
